title: #327 Workplace Exercise
prompt: Exercise is essential for health, and exercise in the workplace makes employees less absent from work. All employers should provide exercise facilities in the workplace. What is your opinion? Support your opinion with personal examples.

promptSegments.text: Exercise is essential for health, and exercise in the workplace makes employees less absent from work.
All employers should provide exercise facilities in the workplace.
Support your opinion with personal examples.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Sử dụng các dẫn chứng thực tế thuyết phục để củng cố luận điểm.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point discusses how exercise facilities improve physical health and reduce sickness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point discusses how exercise facilities improve physical health and reduce sickness.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point discusses how exercise helps improve mental well-being and job satisfaction.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point discusses how exercise helps improve mental well-being and job satisfaction.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Companies should not be forced to provide exercise facilities at work because simple changes are enough.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Companies should not be forced to provide exercise facilities at work because simple changes are enough.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Mandatory exercise facilities are bad because people prefer to manage their own health outside of work.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mandatory exercise facilities are bad because people prefer to manage their own health outside of work.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Providing exercise facilities at work helps staff stay fit and healthy by giving them a chance to move their bodies during the workday, which boosts their energy.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Providing exercise facilities at work helps staff stay fit and healthy by giving them a chance to move their bodies during the workday, which boosts their energy.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Workplace exercise also improves staff focus and productivity because physical movement can clear the mind and reduce stress, allowing workers to complete tasks faster.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Workplace exercise also improves staff focus and productivity because physical movement can clear the mind and reduce stress, allowing workers to complete tasks faster.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Workplace exercise is not always necessary for maintaining employee health because people can get enough physical activity outside of their job roles in everyday life, such as walking to work or using stairs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Workplace exercise is not always necessary for maintaining employee health because people can get enough physical activity outside of their job roles in everyday life, such as walking to work or using stairs.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, providing exercise facilities at work is not always the best approach because such facilities might not suit every type of employee, and forcing people to use specific equipment can cause stress.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, providing exercise facilities at work is not always the best approach because such facilities might not suit every type of employee, and forcing people to use specific equipment can cause stress.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ trả lời câu hỏi đầu tiên mà bỏ quên yêu cầu thứ hai; cần giải quyết cả hai khía cạnh công bằng.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ diễn đạt lại đề bài mà quên khẳng định rõ lập trường cá nhân ở cả mở bài và kết bài.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh dùng các câu văn mẫu học thuộc lòng chung chung và các ý lạc đề.
